_comment: opencode provider config for the WEEKLY CI E2E (workflow: e2e-weekly.yml).
Copied to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json by the job, the same way
Distinct from the docker one deliberately: that config carries the desktop
harness environment (DISPLAY=:99, GTK_A11Y, isolated-display markers) which is
meaningless on a headless CI runner and would point robotmcp at an X display
that does not exist. This one declares only what CI needs.
MiniMax-only, using MINIMAX_API_KEY. The previous OpenRouter roster could not
execute in CI at all - n_valid=0/5 with total_calls=0 on every model - which
kept the weekly workflow red for 8+ consecutive scheduled runs.
